description_en: Configures the switch and level of the Anti-DDoS Global Mitigation Policy mitigation policies
description_zh: 配置DDoS全局防护策略的开关和等级
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo config-domain-security-profile --domain example.aliyundoc.com --config global_rule_mode_:_hard --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigDomainSecurityProfile

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website service.
The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The Anti-DDoS Global Mitigation Policy for Protection for Website Services. The structure is as follows:
global_rule_mode: String type. Optional. The protection level of the DDoS global mitigation feature. Valid values:
    - weak: Loose.
    - default: Normal.
    - hard: Strict.
global_rule_enable: Integer type. Optional. The switch of the DDoS global mitigation feature. Valid values:
    - 0: Shutdown.
    - 1: Enabled.

The Blacklist/Whitelist feature of the custom mitigation policies for Protection for Website Services. The structure is as follows:
bwlist_enable: Integer type. Optional. The switch of the custom mitigation policy blacklist/whitelist. Valid values:
    - 0: Shutdown.
    - 1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
配置网站业务DDoS全局防护策略，具体结构如下。
global_rule_mode：String类型，可选，DDoS全局防护功能的防护等级。取值：
    - weak：宽松
    - default：正常
    - hard：严格
global_rule_enable：integer类型，可选，DDoS全局防护功能的开关。取值：
    - 0：关闭
    - 1：开启

配置网站业务DDoS防护自定义防护策略黑/白名单防护策略功能，具体结构如下。
bwlist_enable：integer类型，可选，自定义防护策略黑/白名单开关。取值：
    - 0：关闭
    - 1：开启
parameters.name: config

RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
